🎓 College Event Management System (CampusPulse)

Full-Stack MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) Web Application

A complete, responsive collegiate event management platform built specifically for B.Tech college project demonstrations and viva examinations, featuring Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Organizer, Student), full CRUD operations, live event registration with capacity thresholds, printable E-Tickets, and JWT authentication.

🌟 Project Architecture & Highlights

  1. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):

    • Admin: Full system control — create, edit, and delete any event; view all registered campus participants; manage user accounts and elevate/demote user roles.

    • Organizer: Departmental coordinator role — create, update, and manage hosted events; inspect registrant rosters; track seat capacity.

    • Student: View categorized events; reserve seats with instant E-Ticket generation; cancel bookings; view and print event entry passes.

  2. Full CRUD Event Management:

    • Create: Add college events with title, description, category (Technical, Cultural, Sports, Workshop, Seminar, Academic, Social), date, time, venue, seat limit, status, and banner imagery.

    • Read: Live search by keyword/venue/organizer, multi-category filter pills, status filters (Upcoming, Ongoing, Completed, Cancelled), and comprehensive event details view.

    • Update: Edit event schedule, venue, capacity, or status.

    • Delete: Remove events with confirmation modals and cascading cleanup of registrations.

  3. Event Registration & Overbooking Prevention:

    • Automated seat capacity tracking (registeredParticipants / maxParticipants).

    • Hard stop when max participants are reached.

    • Prevention of duplicate registrations per student.

    • Self-service cancellation with automatic seat count replenishment.

    • Digital E-Ticket modal with unique Ticket ID (TKT-HN26-XXXXX), student credentials, entry gate barcode/QR graphics, and print support.

  4. Participant Roster & CSV Export:

    • Tabular view of attendees displaying Student Name, Email, Department, Roll Number, Event, Registration Date, and Status.

    • One-click Export CSV Roster for event check-in and attendance records.

  5. User Management:

    • Complete Admin control panel: view registered users, add new accounts, edit credentials, change roles (Admin, Organizer, Student), and delete accounts.

  6. Interactive B.Tech Viva & Presentation Guide:

    • Built-in Viva Guide Modal accessible from the navigation bar containing:

      • Full MERN Stack Architecture Diagrams.

      • MongoDB / Mongoose Document Schemas (users, events, registrations).

      • REST API Contract Table with HTTP verbs and authorization roles.

      • Frequently asked examiner viva questions and sample answers.

🔑 Viva Demonstration Credentials & 1-Click Quick Login

The application is pre-seeded with sample data. Use the 1-Click Viva Examiner Login buttons on the Login page or the top navigation bar dropdown to switch between roles during demonstrations:

RoleEmailPasswordPermissions
Adminadmin@college.eduadmin123Complete administrative access, user CRUD, event CRUD
Organizerorganizer@college.eduorganizer123Create & edit departmental events, view participants
Studentstudent@college.edustudent123Browse events, register, view & print E-Tickets

📡 REST API Endpoints

  • Auth: POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me, PUT /api/auth/profile

  • Events: GET /api/events, GET /api/events/:id, POST /api/events, PUT /api/events/:id, DELETE /api/events/:id, GET /api/events/my-events

  • Registrations: POST /api/events/:id/register, DELETE /api/events/:id/register, GET /api/events/:id/participants, GET /api/registrations/my-registrations

  • Participants: GET /api/dashboard/participants

  • Users: GET /api/users, POST /api/users, PUT /api/users/:id, DELETE /api/users/:id

  • Dashboard: GET /api/dashboard/stats, GET /api/status
